scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.test: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm --prefix backend test" "npm --prefix frontend test"
scripts.test:coverage: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm --prefix backend run test:coverage" "npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage"
